d:
Meta took down or restricted more than 5.4 million social media posts on orders from government agencies in India. The restrictions have surged almost 13,000% compared to the same period last year. What is driving this takedown surge? Is it an attack on free speech online? Palki Sharma tells you.
The Palki Sharma Show is a news, opinions and current affairs show from IGR.
The show covers the biggest stories of our time and helps the audience make sense of an increasingly complex world.
The show is anchored by Palki Sharma, Founder, IGR.
